About Divine Media

Printing, signage & branding — all under one roof.

Divine Media is a printing, signage and outdoor branding shop based in Kakadeo, Kanpur. We make everything from visiting cards and pamphlets to LED sign boards, vinyl graphics, vehicle branding and large hoardings, so you can get all your print and signage work done in one place, with one point of contact.

Who we are

We are a Kanpur-based print, signage and outdoor-branding partner for shops, offices, schools, clinics, event organisers, brands and individuals. Whether it's a single name plate or branding for a fleet of e-rickshaws, we quote for it — and we talk to you directly on phone and WhatsApp, confirming price and timeline before any work starts.

We currently offer 43 services across six groups: hoardings & outdoor structures, sign boards, vinyl & graphics, vehicle branding, standees & displays, and print & stationery. Can't find exactly what you need on the list? Our custom order option lets you describe it and we'll confirm whether we can make it, along with price and timing.

How ordering works

  1. Browse our services and tap "Add to Enquiry" on everything you need.
  2. Open your enquiry list and choose "Request a Quote."
  3. Send your details — name, phone, address, and sizes/quantities/deadline.
  4. We reply on WhatsApp with pricing and turnaround for everything together.
